description: Source code, configurations, tests, recorded seed-level results and analysis tools for solution-space heterogeneity in federated PDE learning and SB-CFO. Version 1.1.0 includes corrected cylinder geometry-mask alignment, the complete cylinder rerun, updated plotting and six-author metadata. Raw public datasets are obtained separately from their original providers.
